title: Beef and Broccoli Stir-Fry
description: Tender seared beef and bright broccoli in a glossy garlic-ginger sauce.

steps.text: Rinse the rice, then bring it to a boil with 2¼ cups water and a pinch of salt. Cover, turn the heat to low and cook until the water is absorbed, about 15 minutes. Let it stand off the heat, still covered, while you cook.
Toss the beef with the cornstarch. In a small bowl, whisk the soy sauce, brown sugar, garlic, ginger and ⅓ cup water.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large skillet or wok over high heat. Sear the beef in a single layer until browned, 2 to 3 minutes, then move it to a plate.
Add the rest of the oil, the broccoli and a splash of water. Cover and cook until bright green and just tender, 3 to 4 minutes.
Return the beef, pour in the sauce and toss until glossy and thick, 1 to 2 minutes. Top with the green onions and serve over the rice.
